traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Gleicheniaceae: terrestrial ferns of open ground, often forming thickets, on creeping, forking rhizomes; the rachis pinnate to bipinnate or forking again and again, growing on without end, to 7 m; sori round, of a few sporangia, on the underside, without indusium.
